/**
     * Returns the shape used for legend items.

ownership_reason: Only the gold decides, series by series, whether a legend item is listed; hops 1-4 resolve the renderer's dataset index, the dataset (an absent dataset gives an empty collection), the series count and the walk (the first series index and the index step of the plot's row rendering order) and pass them on unchanged. The gold's javadoc promises the legend items for the series of one dataset, skipping only series not visible in the legend and series without an item; a series with default settings is visible in the legend, so an empty collection for one default series is not that collection. No one-line change of the index, the dataset, the count, the first index or the step above the gold lists a series whose own flag is unset under the variant gold. The convention that an unset per-series flag falls back to the base flag is pinned outside the gold by AbstractRenderer.isSeriesVisibleInLegend (the lookup itself, described by the getSeriesVisibleInLegend javadoc as the fallback lookup), by AbstractCategoryItemRenderer.getLegendItem and the XY sibling AbstractXYItemRenderer.getLegendItems, which both use it, and by the passing tests BarRendererTests testGetLegendItem (a default series has an item, an explicit FALSE removes it) and XYPlotTests testGetLegendItems (two default one-series datasets give 2 items).
